title: Acceptance probability identity
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean circuit on $n$ input bits, let $w$ be an input word, and let $p$ be a Boolean proof word of the circuit’s prescribed proof length. The inner function tester’s acceptance probability on the combined word $(w,p)$ equals the acceptance probability of the homogeneous quadratic PCPP verifier for the circuit’s quadratic system, using the extension proof and inner proof obtained by restricting $p$ to their respective portions.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean proof word of the prescribed length
